senses.gloss:
€1P. (खदति, खदित) 
__1 To be steady, firm. 
__2 To strike, hurt, kill.

€1P. (खादति, खादित) 
__1 To eat, devour, feed; to prey upon, bite; प्राक्पादयोः पतति खादति पृष्ठमांसम् [[H. 1. 78]]; खादन्मांसं न दुष्यति [[Ms. 5. 32]], 53; [[Bk. 6. 6]]; 9. 78, 14. 87, 101; 15. 35. 
__2 To hurt.

[खद्-किरच्] 
__1 N. of a tree, Acacia Catechu; [[Y. 1. 302.]] 
__2 An epithet of Indra. 
__3 The moon. 
-Comp. 
-कुणः the fruit-time of the Khadira tree. 
-पत्रिका, -पत्री a sensitive plant. 
-सारः catechu.

a. Eating, devouring. 
-दः 
__1 Eating, chewing. 
__2 Food; यत् पुरा परिवेषात् खादमाहरन्ति [[Av. 9. 6. 12.]]

a. (-दिका f.) [खाद्-ण्वुल्] Eating, consuming. 
-कः 
__1 A debtor. 
__2 An eater, consumer; [[Ms. 5. 51.]]
[खादत मोदध्वमिति सततं यत्राभिधीयते] Eating and being glad; cf. “Eat, drink and be merry”; so खादतवमता, खादताचमता; cf. [[P. II. 1. 72.]]

[खाद्-करणे-ल्युट्] A tooth. 
-नम् 
__1 Eating, chewing. 
__2 Food; अश्वानां खादने नाहमर्थी नान्येन केनचित् [[Rām. 2. 50. 45.]]

a. (-री f.) [खदिरस्येदं, अण्] Made of or coming from, the Khadira tree; खादिरं यूपं कुर्वीत; [[Ms. 2. 45.]] 
-रः Catechu.
(? खाद्यादृपाकिक possibly) The head of superintendents of the royal kitchen; [[GI. 20.]]
